title: Belarus: a strategic gateway to Eurasia for Italian businesses
program: Opening remarks — Mario Ubaldi and Viktoria Gubanova, VIKUB
Investment climate and incentives in Belarus — NAIP representatives
Specific requests from Belarusian businesses across five sectors — NAIP representatives
Presentations by Belarusian companies with real needs for supplies, technologies and partnerships
Tax session — taxation and international agreements (Belarusian tax specialist)
Logistics and certification — practical aspects of market entry
